findings.evidenceJa: 後悔も希望も感じさせない幽鬼のまま
findings.governingReading: remaining a ghostlike being who betrayed neither regret nor hope
findings.explanation: Kuzuki’s defining ghostlike existence disappears from his epitaph.

findings.evidenceJa: 葛木を事も無げに殺したアーチャー
findings.governingReading: Archer for killing Kuzuki as though it were nothing
findings.explanation: Archer’s chilling lack of effort and concern disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 磔の祭壇の前
findings.governingReading: before the crucifixion altar
findings.explanation: The image tying Saber’s captivity to crucifixion disappears.

findings.highlight: pushes me forcefully to the side
findings.evidenceJa: 横殴りに、力任せに倒された
findings.governingReading: I am knocked down sideways with brute force
findings.explanation: Saber’s desperate bodily interception is reduced to a shove.

findings.evidenceJa: 容赦なく地面に激突する
findings.governingReading: slams mercilessly into the floor
findings.explanation: The violence of Shirou’s impact disappears.

findings.highlight: Numerous swords lie on the floor
findings.evidenceJa: 無数の剣が突き刺さっている
findings.governingReading: countless swords stand embedded in the floor
findings.explanation: The weapons’ lethal orientation and impact are reversed.

findings.evidenceJa: 咄嗟に俺を庇ってくれた
findings.governingReading: instantly protected me
findings.explanation: The English reports the mechanism but omits Saber’s protective intention and success.

findings.highlight: I don’t know why, but I just cannot approve of him
findings.evidenceJa: その理由も分からず、ただ認められないと否定し続けた
findings.governingReading: without knowing why, we had continued denying each other as something we could never accept
findings.explanation: The sustained reciprocal conflict becomes Shirou’s present one-sided disapproval.

findings.highlight: A swarm of swords about two meters high
findings.evidenceJa: 二メートル近い大剣の群れ
findings.governingReading: a cluster of great swords nearly two meters long
findings.explanation: The swords’ individual size becomes the height of the group.

findings.evidenceJa: 円形の鉄格子
findings.governingReading: a circular cage of iron bars
findings.explanation: The physical mechanism of Rin’s confinement disappears.

findings.highlight: a circle big enough for one person to fit in
findings.evidenceJa: かろうじて立っていられる輪
findings.governingReading: a ring in which one person can barely remain standing
findings.explanation: The cage’s constricting size is weakened to adequate fit.

findings.evidenceJa: やっぱりなんでよ
findings.governingReading: Just as I feared—but why
findings.explanation: A missing separator fuses Rin’s realization and demand.

findings.evidenceJa: この身を埋めているのは後悔だけ
findings.governingReading: nothing but regret fills this body of mine
findings.explanation: Archer’s regret is embodied throughout his existence; the English confines it to cognition.

findings.highlight: does not have his rights as a Master
findings.evidenceJa: マスターの資格がない
findings.governingReading: no longer possesses the qualification to be a Master
findings.explanation: Loss of magical status is recast as legal or moral rights.

findings.evidenceJa: 私の一方的な誓いに応えてくれた
findings.governingReading: he answered an oath I had imposed unilaterally
findings.explanation: Saber’s acknowledgment that her vow was one-sided disappears.

findings.highlight: unable to stand for even a few seconds
findings.evidenceJa: わずか数秒の剣舞さえ行えず
findings.governingReading: unable to perform even a few seconds of swordplay
findings.explanation: Saber’s lost ability to exchange blades becomes inability to stand.

findings.evidenceJa: キャスターの呪縛に抗い続けた
findings.governingReading: continuing to resist Caster’s curse bindings
findings.explanation: The mechanism controlling Saber is mislabeled as a Command Spell.

findings.evidenceJa: だがおまえの体は
findings.governingReading: But can your body
findings.explanation: A missing space fuses Archer’s adversative and question.

findings.highlight: Magic Circuit has its limiter full from all the projection magic
findings.evidenceJa: 投影によって回転を速められた魔術回路
findings.governingReading: Magic Circuits driven to spin faster by projection are at their limiters
findings.explanation: The mechanical cause and motion of Shirou’s overload become generic accumulated use.

findings.evidenceJa: く黙りやがれ
findings.governingReading: Guh—shut up
findings.explanation: A missing separator produces “Kushut.”

findings.evidenceJa: なりふり構わずに剣を合わせた
findings.governingReading: I clash blades without regard for appearances
findings.explanation: The contact with Archer’s weapons disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 理想に他ならないとしたら
findings.governingReading: if he is none other than Shirou Emiya’s ideal
findings.explanation: A conditional realization is promoted into asserted fact before the thought completes.

findings.highlight: my insides are bleeding and about to give out
findings.evidenceJa: 中身が血を流して、ズタズタに崩れようと
findings.governingReading: my insides are bleeding and on the verge of collapsing, torn to pieces
findings.explanation: Catastrophic internal destruction becomes generic physical failure.

findings.evidenceJa: 凛とした遠坂の声
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka’s clear, resolute voice
findings.explanation: Rin’s composure and firmness are replaced by an ill-fitting chivalric quality.

findings.evidenceJa: 舌を打つアーチャー
findings.governingReading: Archer clicks his tongue
findings.explanation: Archer’s audible irritation is replaced by a different bodily reaction.

findings.highlight: Now will be the time to rethink
findings.evidenceJa: 考え直すのなら今のうちです
findings.governingReading: If you mean to reconsider, do it while there is still time
findings.explanation: Saber’s bounded warning becomes malformed future-time English.

findings.evidenceJa: 有無を言わせず、アーチャーは突進した
findings.governingReading: Without allowing an answer, Archer charges
findings.explanation: Archer’s refusal to let Saber respond disappears from the action.

findings.evidenceJa: 一歩も引かず
findings.governingReading: without giving a single step
findings.explanation: Saber’s physical refusal to yield ground becomes an emotional reaction.

findings.evidenceJa: たまらず引き下がるアーチャー
findings.governingReading: Unable to withstand it, Archer retreats
findings.explanation: The pressure forcing Archer backward disappears.

findings.highlight: Saber’s sword will kill him if he tries to counter
findings.evidenceJa: 反撃を試みれば、その隙にセイバーの剣が額を打つ
findings.governingReading: if he attempts a counterattack, Saber’s sword will strike his forehead in the opening
findings.explanation: The exact opening and blow are replaced by the inferred outcome of death.

findings.evidenceJa: 必殺の一撃
findings.governingReading: the fatal blow
findings.explanation: The decisive lethality of Saber’s finishing strike disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 額から両断する
findings.governingReading: cleave him in two from the forehead down
findings.explanation: A full-body bisection is narrowed to damage to the head.

findings.highlight: if he loosens his power on the twin swords
findings.evidenceJa: 双剣をわずかでも緩ませれば
findings.governingReading: if he lets the crossed swords slacken even slightly
findings.explanation: The physical lock between the crossed blades becomes unnatural control over “power.”

findings.evidenceJa: 呼吸は千々に乱れている
findings.governingReading: his breathing is ragged and utterly disordered
findings.explanation: Archer’s severe respiratory distress becomes ordinary exertion.

findings.highlight: you do not have a Master to keep you in this world
findings.evidenceJa: この世に留まるための依り代もいない
findings.governingReading: you have no vessel or anchor through which to remain in this world
findings.explanation: A technical description of the Master’s metaphysical function is reduced to the role label.

findings.evidenceJa: 魔力の供給もままならない
findings.governingReading: cannot obtain an adequate supply of magical energy
findings.explanation: An impaired supply is made an absolute absence.

findings.evidenceJa: ふそれこそ
findings.governingReading: Hah—that
findings.explanation: A missing separator fuses Archer’s laugh into the next word.

findings.evidenceJa: 苦悩に歪むセイバーの顔
findings.governingReading: Saber’s face, contorted with anguish
findings.explanation: Saber’s visible anguish and facial distortion disappear.

findings.evidenceJa: 何故何故
findings.governingReading: Why—why
findings.explanation: A missing separator fuses Saber’s repeated question.

findings.evidenceJa: 間違った望み
findings.governingReading: mistaken wish
findings.explanation: Archer accuses Saber of pursuing the wrong ideal; the English turns this into a judgment of intelligence.

findings.evidenceJa: 一瞬、昏い目をして
findings.governingReading: with darkened eyes for an instant
findings.explanation: Archer’s momentary darkness is replaced by spatial remoteness.

findings.evidenceJa: 戦いを収める気に
findings.governingReading: intend to bring the fight to an end
findings.explanation: Saber asks whether Archer will cease hostilities; the English asks whether he will surrender.

findings.evidenceJa: そんな呪文を口にした
findings.governingReading: utters that incantation
findings.explanation: A completed act of voicing the incantation becomes merely its beginning.

findings.evidenceJa: 今回ではないようだがおそらくは
findings.governingReading: this time, but I will probably
findings.explanation: A missing separator fuses “time” and “and.”

findings.highlight: I will not hold back against you even in this world
findings.evidenceJa: この世界は、おまえが相手でも容赦はせん
findings.governingReading: this world will spare no one who obstructs it, not even you
findings.explanation: The Reality Marble/world’s agency and threat are reassigned to Archer himself.

findings.evidenceJa: 阻むのならばこの世界は
findings.governingReading: stop me, this world will
findings.explanation: A missing separator fuses the object pronoun and following subject.

findings.evidenceJa: 明確に言霊を吐いて
findings.governingReading: clearly gives voice to words of power
findings.explanation: The magically efficacious 言霊 are reduced to ordinary speech.

findings.evidenceJa: 担い手のない剣
findings.governingReading: swords without wielders
findings.explanation: Absence of anyone to bear or wield the weapons becomes a claim about ownership.

findings.evidenceJa: この世界より編み出されたもの
findings.governingReading: were forged or fashioned from this world
findings.explanation: The Reality Marble’s productive mechanism is weakened into unspecified origin.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂の声は淡々としていた
findings.governingReading: Tohsaka’s voice is matter-of-fact and even
findings.explanation: Rin’s controlled delivery is misread as lack of interest at the identity reveal.

findings.highlight: I will die if I project the holy sword
findings.evidenceJa: 聖剣など投影しては自滅する
findings.governingReading: projecting a holy sword would cause me to destroy myself
findings.explanation: The causal self-destructive cost of projection becomes bare death.

findings.highlight: I have jumped up, run to Saber
findings.evidenceJa: 地を蹴って、セイバーの真横へ走り込んで
findings.governingReading: I kick off the ground and dash directly beside Saber
findings.explanation: Shirou’s grounded acceleration and exact destination become an upward jump and generic approach.

findings.evidenceJa: だめだ、早く
findings.governingReading: Don’t—hurry
findings.explanation: Saber’s urgent prohibition is weakened into an ambiguous “No.”

findings.evidenceJa: 飛び交う十八の剣
findings.governingReading: the eighteen swords flying in every direction
findings.explanation: A surrounding, intersecting flight pattern becomes a single approaching direction.

findings.evidenceJa: 次が迫る
findings.governingReading: The next one closes in
findings.explanation: The sequential arrival of the next sword becomes simultaneous plural motion.

findings.highlight: Something like a cocking hammer goes down in my head
findings.evidenceJa: 撃鉄らしきモノが後頭部に落ちる感じ
findings.governingReading: It feels as though something like a gun hammer drops against the back of my head
findings.explanation: The perceived impact point moves from the back of Shirou’s head to an unspecified place inside it.

findings.evidenceJa: てんじゃねえ、テメェ
findings.governingReading: Don’t screw with me, you bastard
findings.explanation: Shirou’s furious challenge becomes an ungrammatical command to be ridiculous.

findings.evidenceJa: 忌々しげに俺を睨んだ
findings.governingReading: glaring at me in bitter vexation
findings.explanation: Archer’s frustrated resentment at Shirou’s interference is changed into revulsion.

findings.evidenceJa: 聖堂を後にする
findings.governingReading: leaves the church sanctuary
findings.explanation: The Christian location is again mislabeled as a temple.

findings.highlight: I do not have enough power to defeat both of you
findings.evidenceJa: おまえに守られた小僧を仕留めるだけの力はない
findings.governingReading: I lack the strength to finish off the boy while you protect him
findings.explanation: Archer’s inability to kill Shirou through Saber’s defense becomes inability to defeat Saber and Shirou together.

findings.highlight: she is an exchange. As long as I have her
findings.evidenceJa: 交換条件だ。コレがオレの手元にある限り
findings.governingReading: she is a bargaining condition; as long as I hold this leverage
findings.explanation: Rin’s function as the condition securing Shirou’s pursuit becomes the unnatural claim that she herself is an exchange.

findings.highlight: I say so with a shaking throat, not even able to look up
findings.evidenceJa: 震える喉で、見上げる事もできないまま言い放った
findings.governingReading: Unable even to look up, I forcefully declare it through my trembling throat
findings.explanation: Shirou’s act of defiantly throwing down the challenge disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: それだけを口にした
findings.governingReading: I utter only that much
findings.explanation: The strict limit on what Shirou can manage to say disappears and the sentence is attached to his sickness instead.

findings.highlight: I don’t want to hear meaningless things
findings.evidenceJa: 軽口は聞きたくない
findings.governingReading: I don’t want to hear your glib banter
findings.explanation: Archer’s taunting levity is recast as semantically meaningless speech.

findings.evidenceJa: 遠坂に手を出してみろ
findings.governingReading: Just try laying a hand on Tohsaka
findings.explanation: Shirou’s threatening dare becomes a vague instruction.

findings.highlight: I’ll kill you with Saber for sure
findings.evidenceJa: セイバーの手を借りてでも、おまえを殺してやる
findings.governingReading: Even if I have to borrow Saber’s help, I will kill you
findings.explanation: The reluctant means Shirou is willing to use becomes unsupported certainty.

findings.evidenceJa: ぎり、と
findings.governingReading: Gritting hard
findings.explanation: A bodily sound or action under pain is invented as a separate oath.

findings.highlight: scratch my forehead, tearing off the skin
findings.evidenceJa: 額を皮ごと引っ掻いて
findings.governingReading: rake my forehead and its skin with my nails
findings.explanation: Scratching through the skin is escalated into removing it.

findings.highlight: in deference to the specification of the place
findings.evidenceJa: 場所を指定した見返りだ
findings.governingReading: in return for your choosing the place
findings.explanation: A simple negotiated concession becomes pompous, unnatural English.

findings.highlight: It is too early for you
findings.evidenceJa: 無茶をして
findings.governingReading: after pushing yourself so recklessly, it is too soon for you
findings.explanation: Saber’s rebuke of Shirou’s reckless overexertion disappears.

findings.highlight: It is too early for you to use the same projection as Archer
findings.evidenceJa: いくら貴方でもアーチャーと同じ投影をするのは早すぎます
findings.governingReading: Even for you, it is far too soon to perform the same projection as Archer
findings.explanation: Saber’s concession to Shirou’s unusual capacity disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 軋む頭蓋を押さえて
findings.governingReading: clutching my creaking skull
findings.explanation: The physical sensation of Shirou’s skull grinding is reduced to a generic headache.

findings.evidenceJa: まいった
findings.governingReading: This is bad
findings.explanation: Shirou’s rueful reaction to his own collapse disappears.

findings.evidenceJa: 満足にグチを言うコトさえ、出来ないのか
findings.governingReading: I cannot even manage a proper complaint
findings.explanation: The dry joke about being unable to complain properly loses its self-mocking qualifier.

findings.evidenceJa: いいですね、シロウ
findings.governingReading: Understood, Shirou?
findings.explanation: Saber’s direct, firm address to Shirou disappears.
